'''Ganglionic Intelligence''' was an extremely rare type of intelligence among [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Most beings believed that this referred to a [[Hive mind/Legends|hive mind]], but it was actually very different. It had what was called compartmentalized consciousness. This meant that there was one central intelligence, connected to which were many sub-intelligences, all collecting information separately from the central intelligence.

One species known to have ganglionic intelligence was the [[Cephalon]].
